test_transformer_output_shape: test the Gemma4 transformer models to verify output logits shape matches expected dimensions
test_text_only_model: test the Gemma4_31B text-only model to verify vision encoder is excluded from parameters
run_get_output: run the _get_output helper to evaluate transformer model output shape using JAX eval_shape
test_parametrized_transformer: test parametrized Gemma4_E2B, Gemma4_E4B, and Gemma4_31B transformer models with token inputs
review_transformer_test: review the Gemma4 transformer test suite for output shape assertions and text-only configuration
